meta.title: Nido del Parque · Apartment 25 m from Zarcero's park
meta.description: Cozy apartment for 2, just 25 meters from Zarcero's famous topiary park in Costa Rica. Great for short stays: Starlink wifi, hot water and private parking.
meta.ogAlt: Bright bedroom at Nido del Parque in Zarcero
